what_to_detect: A resolution creates an emblem: an effect card that is an emblem moves into the command zone, and later snapshots list it in global.emblems.
near_miss: An Effect resolution that creates a non-emblem effect card in the command zone (a temporary effect), or none.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change to_zone command of the effect card
global.emblems in the next record's snapshot
